morbi.headline: Morbi shows demand recovery for premium tiles despite sudden propane gas cost shocks.
what_changed: Propane gas prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, pressuring kiln margins.
Major branded tile players reported strong Q2 and H1 earnings, signaling industry recovery.
stress_signals: Propane price increase of Rs 7,300/MT creates immediate margin pressure for propane-fired vitrified and wall tile kilns [2f37d34283cf]
improvement_signals: Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit estimates [c28b87e03125]
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins, reflecting broader sector recovery [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c]
what_to_watch: Extent to which MSME tile producers can pass on propane price hikes to end buyers.
Capacity utilization rates across unbranded vitrified and wall tile MSME units.
Working capital line utilization and inventory days among smaller Morbi kiln operators.

surat.headline: Pre-Diwali liquidity stress, defaults, and operational disruptions impact Surat textile and diamond clusters.
what_changed: Pre-Diwali default and wage payment issues emerging across diamond polishing and cutting units.
Electricity crisis and power cuts causing severe operational losses in the textile sector.
Long-standing labor friction in the embroidery sub-segment and broker payment frauds impacting cash flows.
Technical textiles gaining traction via defence fabric expansion and early luxury auto collaboration.
stress_signals: A major pre-Diwali default (uthamnu) involving crores by a diamond trader and over ₹20 lakh in unpaid wages to artisans [8f729a2b282e, 402ab705574d, c8a89bd2019b].
A textile mill operator defrauded of ₹1.69 crore through a broker delivery scam [25d6a0f6dbec].
Pre-Diwali power cuts threatening ₹300 crore weekly losses in textiles alongside market lighting curtailments [37c492915105, 5ae803461fe0].
Three-month labour dispute disrupting job-work machine operations in the embroidery sector [8a31a5a2c20c].
improvement_signals: Surat expands into defence fabrics and explores technical textile collaboration with Mercedes-Benz [c4aec155608f, 3a4ce1852d7c].
Textile export growth anticipated via the India-New Zealand FTA while gem exporters rebuild US market presence [8e92d85d894d, 37e6ab2a18cd].
what_to_watch: Receivables health and unverified broker-backed fabric deliveries in MMF textile mill accounts.
Adherence to pre-Diwali wage/bonus payouts and default risk in diamond processing units.
Power availability and operational recovery in textile processing houses and embroidery units.
